# compute max by play_count
max_song = None
max_play = None
for s in all_songs:
    pc = s.get('play_count')
    # ensure numeric
    try:
        pc_num = float(pc)
    except Exception:
        continue
    if (max_play is None) or (pc_num > max_play):
        max_play = pc_num
        max_song = s
print('max_play:', max_play)
print('max_song:', max_song)
